acceptance_predicates.description: The current make update failure and its Cargo lockfile cause are recorded against an exact source head.
Dependency refresh and locked validation are separate explicit operations; no lock-mutating Cargo command receives --locked.
Clean-tree, fast-forward, pinned-toolchain, bounded-command, and failure-propagation boundaries remain fail-closed.
Positive and negative tests cover refresh success, unchanged lock validation, dirty trees, lockfile-write failure, and refresh failure.
Make help and README accurately explain the repaired update behavior and how Cargo.lock changes are reviewed.

definition_of_done: Signed+DCO repair is independently reviewed and merged into protected ASB main.
Focused and full applicable gates pass on the exact reviewed head.
All required exact-main post-merge workflows pass and durable state records the original failure and repaired evidence.

inputs.description: Current repository Makefile update target and its locked Cargo invocation.
ASB DEVELOPMENT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, QUALITY.md, and QUALITY_GATES.md.
User-observed cargo update --locked cannot update the lock file failure.

outputs.description: Corrected Make update lifecycle with tests and documentation.
Signed PR, exact merge, CI, post-merge receipt, and durable state release.

gates.description: Make update repair and all positive/negative lockfile tests pass.
Locked build, test, documentation, and dependency integrity gates pass.
Exact reviewed PR and protected-main post-merge workflows pass.
